title: finding(tooling): the citation census carves out ITS OWN fixtures and nothing else — another instrument’s deliberate decoy address is reported as a rotted citation
body:
`SELF_FILES` carves the citation census and its differential gate out of their own population — **and nothing carves out any OTHER instrument's deliberate citation fixtures.** A decoy that exists precisely because it must NOT resolve is read as a citation that does not resolve, and reported.

Dedup keywords: `cross-file-line-citation-census` · `SELF_FILES` · decoy fixture counted as a finding · self-instrument negative fixture · `check-half-states` cites `check-type-check-coverage.mjs:1679`

⛔ Not claimed, not dispatched, no code written. ⛔ No labels set here — the filing seat does not grade.

## The carve-out, quoted with its SCOPE

`scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs:264`:

```js
export const SELF_FILES = new Set([
  'scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs',
  'scripts/__tests__/cross-file-line-citation-census.test.ts',
  'scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs',
  'scripts/__tests__/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.test.ts',
]);
```

Its docblock says why, and the reason generalises further than the list does:

> The instrument may not count itself: both files carry addresses as fixtures. … It is one list for BOTH readers. … two carve-out lists over one population drift, and the direction they drift in is silent.

⭐ **That reasoning is correct and the list is right for what it covers.** ⛔ This card does **not** ask to widen it by name — see the deliverable. It observes that *"carries addresses as fixtures"* is a property of **many** instruments in this tree, and only four files are named.

## The attested instances — three, verified by reading the citing text

`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` cites `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs:1679` at **:2749**, **:11229** and **:11235**. The census reports all three `[out-of-range]`. The cited file is **808 lines** (`wc -l`; ⚠️ the census prints `file has 809 lines` — a trailing-newline convention difference, ⛔ not a disagreement about the verdict: 1679 is out of range either way).

And the citing comment says, in its own words, that this is deliberate:

> the measured decoys are `Field` and `FIXTURE_CAPTURED_NEGATED` … and `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs:1679` (a real path with a line suffix — tracked as a file, NOT as that token, so the suffix form correctly fails). Each of those is a row this index would otherwise have rendered wrong.

⇒ the address is **chosen to be unresolvable**. Repairing it would destroy the fixture; reporting it teaches a reader to repair it. That is the defect: **the census cannot tell a rotted pointer from a negative control**, and its `out-of-range` verdict reads identically for both.

## ⛔ THE POPULATION IS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THAT IS DELIVERABLE #1

Census on `origin/main` at HEAD `3ecc369bf`, all six controls passing (`✓ 6 of 6 control(s) passed -- this run IS a reading`):

| reading | value |
|:--|--:|
| cross-file citations in the population | **1271** |
| of which FALSE against today's tree | **598** |
| of which resolve to their content | 229 |
| of which the census does NOT judge | 444 |
| excluded, the two citation readers and their tests | **112** |
| `scripts/__tests__` | 110 total, **29 false** |
| `scripts` | 82 total, **41 false** |
| `scripts/pm` | 3 total, **3 false** |

⛔ **This card does NOT claim what fraction of those are deliberate fixtures.** It has three verified instances and a plausible shape, and it says so rather than publishing a number it did not measure. ⇒ **deliverable #1 is that classification**, over `scripts/`, `scripts/__tests__/` and `eslint-rules/` at least: for each false citation, is it a rotted pointer or a negative control the citing file's own text declares?

⭐ **The answer decides the card.** If deliberate fixtures are a handful, naming them is noise and this closes. If they are a substantial share of `scripts/`'s 41 and `scripts/__tests__`'s 29, then the census's headline **598 false** is inflated by an unknown amount by instruments doing their job correctly — and a reader cannot act on a number with an unmeasured floor of correct-by-construction entries in it.

## What would falsify this card

- The three instances are the only ones in the tree ⇒ noise, close it.
- Or: there is already a mechanism that distinguishes them which this filing did not find ⇒ close it and say where.

⛔ **And explicitly NOT proposed here**: extending `SELF_FILES` by listing more paths. A by-name list over a property that holds of many files is the drift the census's own docblock warns about, one level up. If a carve-out is the answer, it should key on something the citing file *declares*, ⛔ not on a list someone must remember to extend.
